verdict.rationale: Spline documents direct design-to-code output. Scenes export as Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js or react-three-fiber code, as a self-contained self-hosted ZIP with its runtime, or as an embeddable `<spline-viewer>` web component, and a Code API lets existing code drive the scene. Missing for 10: any mapping of Spline components to a codebase's own components, evidence that the exported code is clean and idiomatic rather than a runtime wrapper, evidence that the 2D/Hana interface designs export to production code, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the output is shippable.
